pages.text: Find $(item)Astral geodes$() in new Overworld terrain. Leave budding blocks in place: they grow buds into clusters and cannot be collected, even with Silk Touch.$(br2)Mine mature clusters with a pickaxe for four $(item)Astral Gems$(). Fortune can add more.

pages.title: Growing crystals
pages.text: A mature cluster. Buds grow through three smaller stages.

pages.title: Astral armor trim
pages.text: Combine an armor trim template, trimmable armor, and an $(item)Astral Gem$() at a smithing table. The template determines the pattern. Astral material gives the trim a blue base and the animated astral effect; the rest of the armor keeps its normal appearance.
